info.title: Coins Agent Check
info.description: Read-only blockchain evidence and deterministic tools. Check /healthz and /api/v1/services before purchasing; never pay while newPurchasesEnabled is false. Base L2 confirmations are not Ethereum finality. Calldata interpretation is not simulation or a safety audit.
info.x-guidance: Paid reports are offered to actual customers outside mainland China only, where lawful and subject to sanctions. Read /privacy.html; an Agent hosting location does not establish customer eligibility. Read /SKILL.md. First inspect /demo/usdc-receipt.json for one fixed, free public historical receipt; it is not the caller's payment. Read /examples/agentcash.md for merchant integration. Free tools do not execute transactions. Paid reports cost 0.02 Base USDC. Replace all example addresses, hashes and country codes with real, authorized input. Never infer the customer country from Agent hosting. Preserve the private Idempotency-Key, exact body and original authorization for retries; never create another payment to repair an unresolved one. No private keys or wallet sessions are accepted.

X402Payment.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
X402Payment.description: Per-request x402 v2 authorization from an approved buyer. First request may be unauthenticated to inspect 402 terms. Never send a wallet key.
